body:
Adds `research/simdesign-webshell`: scikit-fem 3D linear buckling of the bracket arms vs the closed forms of `simdesign-webbuckle` (validated on the Euler column). Vertical (governing) arm agrees within ~1%; horizontal-arm closed form is conservative by 6–29%. Stylised, mesh not fully converged. README bullet, site entry, tests (3), run log included; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
